\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{calc}
\begin{document}
% A recursion cut past the expansion depth: each level opens a group and
% closes it through macros, and sets a length with calc.
\newlength\len
\def\open{\begingroup}
\def\close{\endgroup}
\def\rec{\open\setlength\len{(\len+1pt)*2}%
  \global\advance\count255 1 \ifnum\count255<1000 \rec\fi\close}
\begingroup
\global\count255=0 \rec
\ifnum\currentgrouplevel=1 \else\gdef\Leaked{}\fi
\endgroup
\ifnum\currentgrouplevel=0 \else\gdef\Leaked{}\fi
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
